statements.quote: In June 2026, we issued a combination of Class A stock and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion, to be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures to scale AI infrastructure and global compute.
statements.notes: $49.6 billion is financing proceeds for general corporate purposes, not a capex amount, so it is not recorded as explicit_amount. The sentence links planned capex to AI infrastructure in words only. No fiscal year is named for the spend, so code applies the year after the reported year.
